data.title: 丛雨 · 花火开始前的团扇
data.description: 【丛雨 · 花火开始前的团扇】穗织河畔的祭典灯笼次第亮起，丛雨穿着金鱼与水纹图案的棉浴衣，绯红腰带在背后结成蝴蝶结。她一手拿团扇轻轻扇风，另一手扶着河边栏杆，抬头等着第一朵烟花——「快看那边！马上就要开始了，可别错过呀！」
data.action: 站在河畔栏杆边，一手拿团扇扇风，另一手扶栏，抬头看花火
data.promptProse: Beside the Hoori riverside railing, Murasame waits for the fireworks in her goldfish-patterned cotton yukata and scarlet obi, gently fanning herself with a round paper fan while her free hand rests on the rail. Festival lanterns paint warm reflections on the water as the first distant burst lights the night sky above her expectant smile.
data.camera: medium shot, paper fan and resting hand visible against the river
